notes: VAT 18% (Law 049/2023 art. 4). The complete art. 8 exemption list (as enacted 2023 and as replaced by Law 009/2025) contains no gold or precious-metals item, so bullion takes 18%. Caveat: art. 7(1)(c) zero-rates 'minerals sold on the domestic market' - read as mine output, not refined investment bullion. Import duty null (EAC CET book not openable).

sources.name: Rwanda Revenue Authority (rra.gov.rw) - Law Nº 049/2023 establishing Value Added Tax (Official Gazette)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 4 sets VAT at 18% for goods and services other than zero-rated ones; the art. 8 exemption list read in full contains no gold or precious metals
sources.quote: The rate of value added tax is – (a) 0% of the value of taxable goods or services that are zero-rated as provided for by this Law; (b) or 18% for other goods and services supplied in Rwanda or imported.
